title: Our Top 5 Stocks to Set It and Forget It in 2026
creator: BWB - Business With Brian
summary: Joseph Hogue (Let's Talk Money!) hosts Brian for a 'must-buy 5 stocks for 2026 both agree on' game: each proposes picks and the other can veto. Final agreed five: Broadcom (Brian's pick; custom AI accelerators, $16B cash +73% YoY, 67% margins, PEG 0.98, earnings growth +188%), Palo Alto Networks (Joseph's pick; dominant in cloud/SASE, 12% operating margin while peers lose money, GARP; Brian holds it, agrees), Walmart (Joseph's pick; category-killer retail, tariff roll-off lifting margins, Vizio/OpenAI ad levers, private-label share gains), Amazon (Brian's pick; AWS re-accelerating to ~20% growth, operating income $12B->69B 2022-24), Nvidia (Brian's pick; 90% data-center GPU share, Vera Rubin 5x inference, $2B/yr AI enterprise software). Rejected: Nebius (Brian's pick; +178% last year, Nvidia Vera Rubin access, $2.4B cash - Joseph vetoed on the 1990s-mainframe-leasing analogy and exploding debt) and SoundHound (Joseph's pick; Brian vetoed on cash burn, 63x price-to-sales, weak moat). Bonus: Joseph called Super Micro a 'no-brainer' deep-value server play (host-only). Calls: AVGO, PANW, WMT, AMZN, NVDA BUY (Brian, all joint picks); NBIS BUY (Brian's own pick, vetoed by Joseph as a joint pick - his stance stands). Note: 'Nebia' = Nebius (NBIS).
